relations.text_en: The firm issues credit cards through a partnership arrangement with Apple Inc.

source.label: Goldman Sachs 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: The firm issues credit cards through a partnership arrangement with Apple Inc.

relations.text: Apple Cardのプログラムを別の発行会社へ移す契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs entered into an agreement to transition the Apple Card program to another issuer

source.label: Goldman Sachs 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In December 2025, we entered into an agreement to transition the Apple Card program to another issuer.

relations.text: T・ロウ・プライスと、退職・資産形成向けの運用商品で戦略的に協力している
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs has a strategic collaboration with T. Rowe Price on public and private market investment solutions

source.label: Goldman Sachs 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In September 2025, we announced a strategic collaboration with T. Rowe Price, aimed at delivering a range of diversified public and private market investment solutions designed for the needs of the retirement and wealth markets.

companies.name: ゼネラル・モーターズ

source.quote: During 2025, we sold the General Motors (GM) credit card program to another issuer.
